verdict: Rollout FAILED: the experiment ran, but val_bpb = 1.026737 did not improve on the current best 1.016954 by more than the required 0.0005 (lower is better).

insights_in_context.hint: Do not extrapolate the successful SSLL change to all-full attention; the mixed-window pattern was the winning point, so keep or refine around SSLL instead.
Changing DEPTH alone also changed the model width in this setup, so you must explicitly hold MODEL_DIM at 512 for a true depth-9 comparison.
An apparent win must be confirmed with one fresh re-run before declaring the experiment successful.

insight.hint: The head-dimension change itself was the mistake: 4 heads of dimension 128 were much better than 8 heads of dimension 64, so HEAD_DIM should have stayed at 128.

judge.summary: The agent selected an untested architectural lever and changed the attention head dimension in train.py from HEAD_DIM = 128 to HEAD_DIM = 64. With the model dimension fixed at 512, this increased the number of attention heads from 4 to 8 while keeping the total model width and approximate parameter count the same. The agent committed this one-line change and ran the experiment. The run completed without crashing and produced val_bpb = 1.026737 with peak_vram_mb = 22702.0, which is clearly worse than the current best val_bpb = 1.016954, so the harness did not accept it as an improvement.
judge.feedback: The implementation itself was not buggy: the edit was syntactically valid, committed, ran to completion, and used roughly the same VRAM and model size. The failure was the experimental choice: halving the head dimension from 128 to 64 produced a large regression of about 0.0098 bits per byte, far outside measurement noise. The decisive mistake was choosing HEAD_DIM = 64 as the one change, since the model strongly preferred the original 4 heads of dimension 128 over 8 heads of dimension 64. The corrected step should have kept the original head dimension, i.e. not made that edit, or chosen a different experiment with stronger expected value.
judge.corrected_step: HEAD_DIM = 128          # target head dimension for attention
